notes.title: The Past Within - Update 7.6.0.1
notes.notes:
Spring is officially here and with it, we bring you new patch notes in our 5th update for The Past Within and some small news to go with it all!

First of all, we’d like to thank everyone who joined our official [url=https://discord.gg/rustylake]Rusty Lake Discord[/url]! We’re now at over 200k users and we’re just blown away by how many people we see playing The Past Within in our Voice Cube channels, sharing theories, fan arts, Rusty Lake memes and more!

And just another big thank you to everyone who tried our co-op experience! If you haven’t yet and are curious to play it with a friend or someone from our aforementioned Discord, now is the perfect time to do so! The Past Within, together with the rest of our Rusty Lake catalogue of games, is 40% off as part of the Steam Spring Sale. The sale lasts until March 23rd!

And now back to the patch notes for The Past Within!

[b]Patch Notes 7.6.0.1[/b]
[list][*] Fixed several save game related crashes
[*] Fixed Steam Achievements not unlocking properly
[*] Fixed a crash with Arabic device languages
[*] Fixed localization issue in main menu
[*] Fixed localization issue in credits
[*] Added TikTok icon
[*] Added Ukrainian and Finnish language support
[/list]
We hope you’ll enjoy Update no.5! Have a great week and a fantastic spring! 

* Thanks for your support! Feel free to reach out if you want to help us translating the game to more languages.

notes.title: [Update] Best Kept Memory and the secrets behind the MemoryCube_Recordings
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=F-Wf-s0hJck;full][/previewyoutube]
Is Best Kept Memory behind the MemoryCube_Recordings?

We have reasons to believe that the Memory Cube Recordings were linked to an old clinic from the early 2000s that specialised in memory manipulation procedures. This old commercial might just be the key piece of evidence to support this claim.
We tried to call Best Kept Memory (+31854015026) and reached out to them through their website: BestKeptMemory.com, but so far we received no response.

🌐 https://bestkeptmemory.com 
☎️ (+31) 854015026

Help us investigate on our [url=https://discord.gg/rustylake]Discord channel[/url]!

[b][Update][/b]
[previewyoutube=2cZGtM2iLp8;full][/previewyoutube]
Archived news broadcast: Memory manipulation clinic "Best Kept Memory" comes under fire for gross misconduct and breach of privacy. Thousands of memories stored at their facility might not be as safe as we were led to believe!

Marketing Director Chad shared his response: security measures have taken place and BestKeptMemory.com and its backend are now secure for all current and future clients.

notes.title: One week after release + 40% Launch discount is extended 🎉
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515210/The_Past_Within/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/marketing/6832373503614514776//images/message_image.gif[/img][/url]

Thank you so much for your incredible support for The Past Within since its release! We are honoured to read so many amazing reviews from our fans trying out our first co-op experience, it truly means a lot! Together with all your praise, we’ve also received some great constructive feedback from you, especially about the length of the game. We can completely understand if the game felt too short, or the experience may not be something for you, or perhaps you still prefer a single-player game from us. We’re very grateful to everyone that gave our game a try, and appreciate all of you that took the time to let us know what your experience was like overall!

Our team put 2.5 years of blood, sweat and tears (not to be confused with the in-game substances) into this project to create something new and exciting. It all started with what we called the shoebox idea: a 3D puzzle box with a peephole through which you could see a classical 2D room. But back then we had no idea what the game could or would become. We kept on iterating and decided to keep on pushing even when it became really hard and we almost pulled the plug out of the project. Luckily the first beta test of the co-op mechanism gave us the confidence to move forward and challenge ourselves in many ways: we had to move from Flash to Unity, we had to transform our distinctive 2D style into 3D style and, yes, also learn to create co-op puzzles for the first time ever. Keep in mind that we, as developers, also need to go out of our comfort zone from time to time in order to create new things. Feel free to read more background info about the development in our [url=https://blog.rustylake.com/tag/devlog/]devlogs[/url] or in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1515210/view/3408689146756553776]community interview[/url]. And we didn't sit still while developing The Past Within; [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1515210/view/3360263387994541102]a new metro will arrive[/url] sooner than you think!

We are very proud of what The Past Within became and in case you didn't try it yet... we hope you will take the chance to experience it with a friend, a family member, a colleague or even a stranger (feel free to join our [url=https://www.discord.gg/rustylake]Discord.gg/rustylake[/url]). We hope it brings a smile to your face and you both will have a great (and hopefully special) experience together, like we saw on many occasions during the countless of playtest sessions. And now it is still the perfect time to try it, since we were able to extend our 40% launch discount with one more week:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515210/The_Past_Within/

As always, thank you so much for your support and let’s make some (more) memories!

Rusty Lake Team

A few extra things:
- We are working on new trading cards, stay tuned! 
- We have a little contest on [url=https://twitter.com/rustylakecom/status/1589233831013646336?s=20&t=sJgrUhMnVLpvHPtVVhNcFQ]social media[/url] to win an exclusive The Past Within t-shirt.
- Make sure to keep an eye on mysterious broadcasts on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1515210/view/3408689146778426493]Steam page[/url] and [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFHNBcZS1wQsI_Fk1q-j1wx72kQXDmmiQ]Youtube[/url]!
- Luckily we managed to do [url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans//39691524/e4b987388525829201eecc1693f4402d8c0b6710.jpg]a small celebration[/url] with some special black cube cakes, a fitting sacrifice to The Lake ⬛️

notes.title: The Past Within - Patch Notes 7.1.0.0
notes.notes:
Over the past two days, we’ve received an overwhelming amount of feedback and appreciation for our latest game. We’re working hard to respond to everyone and address the issues that some of you have found. With today's update, we bring you an even smoother version of The Past Within! In the patch notes below you can read more about what we’ve improved.

If you haven’t left a review yet, please consider taking a moment to share your experience with us. We couldn’t do this without your invaluable help!

Oh and if you’ve been wondering what’s going on with those mysterious broadcasts on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1515210/allnews/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFHNBcZS1wQsI_Fk1q-j1wx72kQXDmmiQ]Youtube[/url], a lot of people have been puzzling together with the contents of these videos in our [url=https://discord.gg/rustylake]Discord[/url]! If you’re curious to learn more or get involved with the theory-crafting, we hope to see you there soon.

[b]Patch Notes 7.1.0.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Laptops with touch screens are now supported
[*]Low Quality is now supporting more low-end devices
[*]Fixed clock snapping back to certain hours Chapter 1 The Past
[*]Fixed stuck peek hole sliders Chapter 1 The Future
[*]Fixed crash when loading the next chapter
[*]Fixed crash after red emergency lever Chapter 1 The Future[/list]

notes.title: The Past Within goes to Gamescom [Update]
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691524/a0401ac83f8b5dd8c8504e41c71f7d0020bd37e1.png[/img]

Our The Past Within demo build for Gamescom is almost ready! We cannot wait to showcase it at Indie Arena Booth next month! 🤩

Gamescom is our next big The Past Within milestone - we’re currently working on the replayability feature, the save system and testing translations. Ideally, we’ll have most of those features ready and implemented into the demo in time for the event. 
After Gamescom - and the incredible playtesting opportunities the event will offer - we expect to have a very clear picture of what’s next! 

Thank you all for your patience and we hope to see some of you at the event! 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691524/1d0aad548ed36134f3aed408ecec7814e714439c.jpg[/img]

[Update] We are excited to share that our Gamescom preparations are done!

Our Indie Arena Booth will be well stocked with Rusty Lake merch, postcards, stickers, and our new and very cool The Past Within pop-up cubes! ✨⬛️✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39691524/6f21836618cb305d6b307abd9426c4790a54c667.jpg[/img]

We are located in Hall 10.2 and our Booth number is F020g-E-021g (easily recognizable with the blue carpet).
We will share more detailed information on the location of our booth next week! 👀
